chapter.p: Surprisingly; in an unexpected way; being caught off- guard. “I declared what I was going to do, I did it, and you got caught off-guard.” (see e.g., Isaiah 17:1.)1

div.p: 1 “The Doctrine of Christ,” Sept. 11, 2016, transcript of talk, 18–19; Podcast 48: “Prophecy,” Dec. 8, 2018, transcript, 10.
